sections.Profile:
Four Seasons, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1968, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Water Sports, Leisure, Ice Skating, Sports, Original Theme, Weather, Recreation, Hunting, Water skiing
